speaker: S01
english_ref: My name is Wanjiru and I live in Githunguri.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I am forty-two years old.

speaker: S01
english_ref: There are six people in my household.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have four children and three of them are in school.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have lived in this village for twenty years.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I sell milk from my cows every morning.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I earn about eight thousand shillings in a month.

speaker: S01
english_ref: My income is higher during the rainy season.

speaker: S01
english_ref: Some months I do not get any money from the farm.

speaker: S01
english_ref: My husband also works and brings money home.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I spend about three thousand shillings on food every month.

speaker: S01
english_ref: School fees take most of my money.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I pay two hundred shillings for electricity each month.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I buy animal feed twice in a month.

speaker: S01
english_ref: When someone falls sick we spend a lot of money.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have two cows and five goats.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I own one acre of land.

speaker: S01
english_ref: The land has a title deed in my name.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have a water tank and a wheelbarrow.

speaker: S01
english_ref: My house is built of stone.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I borrowed twenty thousand shillings last year.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have finished paying that loan.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I still owe the shopkeeper two thousand shillings.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have never failed to repay a loan.

speaker: S01
english_ref: Once I paid late because the harvest was poor.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I joined this SACCO three years ago.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I save five hundred shillings every week.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have taken two loans from the SACCO before.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I was a guarantor for my neighbour.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have a mobile loan that I pay every month.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I am a member of a women's group in our village.

speaker: S01
english_ref: We contribute one thousand shillings every month.

speaker: S01
english_ref: We take turns receiving the money.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I have been in the group for five years.

speaker: S01
english_ref: The group helped me buy my second cow.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I want the loan to buy a dairy cow.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I will repay the loan from the milk money.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I plan to finish paying within one year.

speaker: S01
english_ref: If the business fails I will sell a goat to repay.

speaker: S01
english_ref: I always keep a record of what I sell.
